name: qwencloud-model-selector
title: QwenCloud Model Selector
description: Pick the right Qwen model for the job: weighs task type, context size, cost and vision needs, then names the model to use.

steps.instruction: Classify the task first: text/code/reasoning, vision understanding, image generation, video generation, or speech.
List the constraints: input length, budget, latency, and whether vision or tool calling is required.
Text and code: qwen-turbo for cheap volume, qwen-plus for balance, qwen-max for hard reasoning.
Vision: qwen3-vl-plus for image and video understanding; local qwen3-vl-8b when offline.
Media generation: Wan models for video, qwen-image for images - via the qwen-mm media tools.
Recommend one primary and one fallback; state cost per million tokens and context window for each.
Verify key and quota for the chosen model before committing; use the free lane when cost must be zero.
